I am 54, been farming these 24 mu for 30 years. My son works in the city, only me and my wife at home, so I cannot do too much heavy work anymore. Let me think about this year.

I keep my fields the same as last year — 6 mu for cotton on the sandy piece near the road, and 18 mu for wheat and maize rotation on the better ground. Cotton price is not so good these years but I already have the sprayer and I know how to grow it, so I keep some.

For wheat, I will plant Jimai seed, the improved kind my neighbor Old Wang used last year, he got over 500 kg per mu. I put one bag of compound fertilizer 15-15-15 per mu as base when I plough, that is 40 kg. Then when wheat turns green in spring I put one bag of urea per mu, 40 kg, that gives about 18 kg nitrogen. So total nitrogen about 24 kg per mu. Phosphorus and potassium about 6 kg each from the compound. I irrigate 3 times — before winter, returning green, and filling grain. I spray 2 times for aphids and rust. Better to spray one extra time than lose the crop, pesticide is cheap compared to losing wheat.

For maize after wheat, I use hybrid seed Zhengdan, everyone around here plants it. I put half bag compound at sowing and one bag urea when knee-high. Maize needs less water than wheat, I water 1 time if the rain is enough, 2 times if dry. Spray 1 time for corn borer.

Cotton needs more care and more fertilizer. I put 2 bags of compound as base and top-dress urea twice. Cotton eats a lot. I spray 7 times for bollworm and aphid — cotton without spray is finished. I water 3 times.

I use rotary tiller, the tractor man comes and does all 24 mu in one day, cheaper than plough.
